name: Broadstairs Community Pantry
short_description: Community pantry providing emergency food support
description: Independent community pantry at St Peters Church Hall. Open Mon
image: Fri 10am-12pm. Provides food parcels and signposting to local services. Self-referral welcome.

dislikes: and Woodford Road. Plots from £30 per year plus £10 key deposit.

name: Pierremont Park Community Garden
short_description: Community garden with accessible raised beds
description: Therapeutic garden with 20 raised beds at Pierremont Park maintained by volunteers. Open for produce collection during summer months. Part of Thanet Community Networks project.

name: Broadstairs Community Orchard
short_description: Heritage apple orchard in public park
description: Restored orchard at Pierremont Park with heritage apple varieties including Cox
image: and Egremont Russet. Open for public picking during harvest season (Sep-Oct). Free for personal use.
